changes.afterTextJa: ヘブロンでダビデのもとに来た軍勢の数が示され、サウルの王国を彼に移すことが主の言葉に沿うと結ばれます。
changes.sourceText: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.
changes.previousContext: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.
changes.nextContext: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.

changes.afterTextJa: レビ人に与えられた町の内訳で、ルベン、ガド、ゼブルン各部族から合計十二の町が割り当てられたと記されます。
changes.sourceText: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
changes.previousContext: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
changes.nextContext: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

changes.afterTextJa: レビ人に与えられた町として、ガド族からラモト・ギレアドとマハナイムが挙げられます。
changes.sourceText: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
changes.previousContext: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;
changes.nextContext: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.
